commits.message:
feat(wts-api): add DELETE /api/items/{id} endpoint

Routes deletion through ItemService into wts-persistence's write repository
seam, returning 204 on success and mapping ItemNotFoundError to 404.

feat(wts-persistence): add delete_item to the write repository seam

Introduces ItemNotFoundError as the not-found signal and implements
delete_item on WriteItemRepository so callers can remove an item by id
without reaching around the repository seam.

feat(wts-web): add per-row delete control to the items list

Adds a delete button per row that calls DELETE /api/items/{id} and removes
the row from local state on success, with no full page reload.
